lines.en: label mikuspecial50:
I tap on Miku’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Miku 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I figure that since soccer practice is over, now is the best time to invite her to the mall and take all of her clothes off.
lines.zh: 我想，既然足球训练已经结束，那现在就是约她去商场、把她衣服全脱掉的最佳时机。

lines.en: Are there going to be other steps in between those two things? Of course. But I’m a lot less interested in those than I am in the end goal here.
lines.zh: 这两件事之间还会有别的步骤吗？当然会。但比起那些步骤，我对最终目标的兴趣大得多。

lines.en: Even if that goal will likely be obscured by a curtain since I doubt Miku’s level of aggression has moved far past spur of the moment makeout sessions.
lines.zh: 尽管那个目标大概会被一层帘子挡住，因为我觉得 Miku 的主动程度应该还没超过一时兴起的亲热。

lines.en: Guess there’s only one way to find out, though.
lines.zh: 不过，要弄清楚也只有一种办法。

lines.en: : Miku?
lines.zh: : Miku？

lines.en: : Heeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeey...
: If you’ve been kidnapped and can’t talk about it, cough and I will call the police.
lines.zh: : 如果你被绑架了、不方便说话，就咳一声，我帮你报警。

lines.en: : I ain’t locked in somebody’s trunk right now, Sensei. I’m friggin’ nervous, okay?
lines.zh: : 我现在可没被锁在谁的后备箱里，Sensei。我只是紧张得要命，好吗？

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 紧张什么？

lines.en: : Well...aren’t ya callin’ me to go on that date thingy we talked about?
lines.zh: : 那啥……你打电话来，不就是要去我们说过的那个约会吗？

lines.en: : I guess, but I don’t really see why you’d be nervous about that when we’re together all the time.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧，可我们不是天天都待在一起吗，我真不知道你有什么好紧张的。

lines.en: : It’s less the whole “spendin’ time together” part and more the “I’m gonna look like an idiot” part.
lines.zh: : 不是“待在一起”那部分让我紧张，是“我肯定会看起来像个傻子”那部分。

lines.en: : Then just...don’t try on idiotic looking clothes? Is that good moral support?
lines.zh: : 那你就……别试那些看起来很傻的衣服？这算是不错的鼓励吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不算，真不算。

lines.en: : Well, do you want to meet up or not? Because if you’re going to back out-
lines.zh: : 那么，你到底要不要见面？因为你要是想反悔——

lines.en: : No! We can still meet up! I’ve just gotta get ready!
lines.zh: : 不！我们还是可以见的！我只是得先准备一下！

lines.en: : Fine. But if you show up with another handwritten intervention sign, I am leaving you stranded at the mall.
lines.zh: : 行。不过你要是再举着一块手写的“干预”牌子出现，我就把你一个人扔在商场。

lines.en: : Okay, good. Cause I was wonderin’ how I was gonna carry it all the way over there in the first place.
lines.zh: : 好，那就好。因为我刚才还在想，我到底要怎么把它一路扛过去呢。

lines.en: : But anyway! I’ll see you there!
lines.zh: : 总之！我们那儿见！

lines.en: : And please don’t make fun of me when ya see me!
lines.zh: : 还有，见到我的时候请别笑话我！

lines.en: : But why-
lines.zh: : 可是为什么——

lines.en: Miku hangs up the phone and I’m suddenly left wondering what exactly I would be making fun of her {i}for.{/i}
lines.zh: Miku 挂了电话，我一下子开始纳闷，我到底有什么好笑话她{i}的{/i}。

lines.en: The only thing I can think of is that stuff Makoto said the other night about doing her hair. But it’s been way too short of a time for it to finish growing and-
lines.zh: 我唯一能想到的，就是 Makoto 那天晚上说的给她弄头发的事。可时间太短了，头发根本长不了那么快，而且——

lines.en: scene amisepiathing
: The same way Maya can eat more than her body weight in food and Ayane can materialize guns and giant bananas out of thin air.
lines.zh: 就像 Maya 能吃下超过她体重的食物，Ayane 能凭空变出枪和巨大的香蕉一样。

lines.en: : Cute girl magic!
lines.zh: : 这就是可爱女孩的魔法！

lines.en: scene noonsky
: No...there’s no way.
lines.zh: : 不……不可能吧。

lines.en: scene black
I’m sure I’ll figure out whatever it is Miku is concerned about as soon as I make it to the mall.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，等我到了商场，就会弄明白 Miku 到底在担心什么。

lines.en: scene mikugirly1
Miku somehow manages to make it there before me and sends me a text about where to meet up with her.
lines.zh: Miku 不知怎么居然比我先到，还发了短信告诉我在哪儿碰头。

lines.en: However, when I approach the meeting spot, I only see a tree.
lines.zh: 然而，等我走到碰头的地方，我只看到一棵树。

lines.en: I wonder if that means anything.
lines.zh: 我在想这是不是有什么含义。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene mikugirly2
: Ah!
: Miku, stop pretending to be a tree and look at me.
lines.zh: : Miku，别装树了，看着我。

lines.en: : I don’t wanna. I look weird.
lines.zh: : 我不要。我看起来很怪。

lines.en: : I can neither confirm nor deny that on account of your face being shielded, but I can assure you that you probably look fine.
lines.zh: : 你的脸被挡着，我既没法确认也没法否认，但我可以向你保证，你大概看起来挺好的。

lines.en: : Sayin’ “probably” kinda makes it sound like ya ain’t so sure, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 说“大概”，听起来就像你自己也不太确定嘛，Sensei。

lines.en: : I know you’re supposed to dress a little better than normal for stuff like this, but I barely even feel like Miku right now.
lines.zh: : 我知道这种场合应该穿得比平时好一点，可我现在几乎都感觉不到自己是 Miku 了。

lines.en: : I feel like that should technically make things easier.
lines.zh: : 我觉得按理说这应该让事情变得更容易才对。

lines.en: : If you don’t feel like Miku, you can act like whoever it is you {i}do{/i} feel like and come out from behind the tree since there would be nothing to be embarrassed about.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得自己不像 Miku，那就当成你现在觉得自己{i}是{/i}的那个人来演，然后从树后面出来——因为那样就没什么是好害羞的了。

lines.en: : The heck are you even talkin’ about right now? That didn’t make any sense at all.
lines.zh: : 你到底在说什么啊？完全听不懂。

lines.en: : Just come out from behind the fucking tree, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你他妈的从树后面出来，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikugirly3
: Did ya really have to curse at me?
lines.zh: : 你非得骂我吗？

lines.en: : Is that...really you?
lines.zh: : 那……真的是你吗？

lines.en: scene mikugirly4
: I told ya it was weird! This kinda look doesn’t suit me at all! And my hair hasn’t been this long in years! It keeps gettin’ in my eyes!
lines.zh: : 我都说了很怪！这种打扮根本不适合我！而且我的头发已经好多年没这么长了！老是往我眼睛里戳！

lines.en: : Where did you even get that outfit? I thought the whole purpose of us coming here was to buy you summer clothes?
lines.zh: : 你那身衣服是从哪儿弄来的？我还以为我们来这儿的目的就是给你买夏装？

lines.en: scene mikugirly5
: Makoto got it for me as a present to celebrate my first time going out with a boy.
lines.zh: : 是 Makoto 送我的礼物，庆祝我第一次和男孩子出去约会。

lines.en: : Well, that explains why it fits you so well. There isn’t really anyone who knows you better than she does.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就怪不得这么合身了。毕竟没有谁比她更了解你了。

lines.en: scene mikugirly6
: Fits me well? You kiddin’ right now? My arms feel so exposed that I can barely even remember I’m wearin’ a shirt.
lines.zh: : 合身？你在开玩笑吧？我的胳膊露得我都快忘了自己还穿着衣服。

lines.en: : Or a...blouse, I think? What am I supposed to call this thing, Sensei? I have no friggin’ clue.
lines.zh: : 还是说……叫衬衫？这玩意儿到底该叫什么啊，Sensei？我他妈的一点头绪都没有。

lines.en: : Let’s just call it “cute” and get on with our date, then.
lines.zh: : 那我们就叫它“可爱”，然后继续约会吧。

lines.en: scene mikugirly7
: Cute?! Oh God- is this how Karin always feels when ya tell her she looks like that?! I think I’m finally startin’ to get it!
lines.zh: : 可爱？！天哪——你对 Karin 说她看起来可爱的时候，她就是这个感觉吗？！我觉得我终于开始懂了！

lines.en: : Miku, step away from the tree.
lines.zh: : Miku，从树后面走出来。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine! I’m goin’! But if you start laughing, I’m runnin’ the heck outta here!
lines.zh: : 行！我出来！不过你要是敢笑，我就立马跑得远远的！

lines.en: scene mikugirly8
: Wow.
: What a turnaround.
lines.zh: : 这转变也太大了。

lines.en: : That’s what I’m sayin’. S’like I’m a completely different person right now. Nearly jumped outta my socks when I looked in the mirror before leavin’.
lines.zh: : 我就是这个意思。感觉我现在完全是另一个人。出门前照镜子的时候，我差点吓得跳起来。

lines.en: : Don’t get me wrong, I thought the whole “tomboyish charm” thing was adorable most of the time, but I think this works just as well.
lines.zh: : 别误会，我一直觉得你那股“假小子的魅力”大部分时候都挺可爱的，不过我觉得现在这样也同样好看。

lines.en: : Even if it ain’t really normal Miku anymore?
lines.zh: : 哪怕这已经不是“正常的 Miku”了？

lines.en: : I don’t see why there can’t be two normal Mikus. All that should really matter is whether or not {i}you{/i} like it.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得为什么不能有两个“正常的 Miku”。真正重要的应该是{i}你自己{/i}喜不喜欢。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to know that, though? I don’t really have any idea how I feel right now.
lines.zh: : 可我怎么知道呢？我现在真的不知道自己是什么感觉。

lines.en: : It’s harder to move around in this...my arms and legs are cold...and I keep feelin’ like people are starin’ at me cause they think I’m some crossdressin’ [teenage]boy.
lines.zh: : 穿着这身动起来好难……我的胳膊和腿都冷……而且我总感觉有人在盯着我看，因为他们觉得我是个异装的 [teenage]男孩。

lines.en: : But I guess...it doesn’t look as bad as I expected it to when I first saw the outfit.
lines.zh: : 不过我想……它并没有我第一次看到这身衣服时以为的那么糟。

lines.en: : I still think it’d look better on somebody like Makoto, though. Sure, she’d have to shrink a few sizes to get it on, but I think she’d make me look like the friggin’ poser I am if she were to wear this.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是觉得，穿在 Makoto 那样的人身上会更好看。当然，她得缩好几个码才穿得进去，不过要是她穿这身，我大概就会被衬成一个该死的冒牌货。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I think it fits you really well.
lines.zh: : 我可不这么想。我觉得这身很适合你。

lines.en: : You also thought a stuffed bear fit me well, so you’re probably just confusin’ me for a normal girl or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 你以前还觉得一只毛绒熊很适合我呢，所以你大概只是把我错当成正常女孩什么的了。

lines.en: : Nah. I know full well that despite everything you say, you’re just as “girly” as everyone else.
lines.zh: : 不是。我很清楚，不管你怎么说，你跟大家一样“女孩子气”。

lines.en: scene mikugirly9
: Am not!
lines.zh: : 我才不是！

lines.en: : Is that really something you want to be arguing?
lines.zh: : 这真的是你想吵的事吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know! Maybe?! I feel...weird! And now {i}you’re{/i} lookin’ at me too and it’s really makin’ me wanna change back into somethin’ more comfortable!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！也许是？！我觉得……好奇怪！而且现在{i}你也{/i}盯着我看了，这真的让我想换回舒服点的衣服！

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be staring so much if I wasn’t so attracted to you, so this is kind of your fault.
lines.zh: : 要不是你这么吸引我，我也不会看这么久，所以这算是你的错。

lines.en: scene mikugirly10
: Not sure how you can feel that way about somebody like me, but...thanks.
lines.zh: : 不知道你怎么会对像我这样的人有这种感觉，不过……谢谢。

lines.en: : I still don’t really think it works, but...I guess I could maybe wear this again in the future if ya actually {i}do{/i} like it as much as ya say.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得不太适合我，不过……如果你{i}真的{/i}像你说的那么喜欢，我想我以后也许还会再穿一次。

lines.en: : Right now, though...I don’t really think I’m comfortable in this, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 不过现在……穿着这身我真的不太自在，Sensei……

lines.en: : And I kinda wanna just go put somethin’ else on.
lines.zh: : 而且我有点想去换点别的穿上。

lines.en: : Havin’ to focus on lookin’ pretty {i}and{/i} bein’ on a date is like...some advanced level technique. I ain’t ready to multitask like that just yet.
lines.zh: : 要一边注意自己好不好看、{i}一边又要{/i}约会，就像是……某种高阶技巧。我还没准备好同时处理这么多事。

lines.en: : Fortunately, I don’t think you need to focus at all in order to be pretty.
lines.zh: : 幸运的是，我觉得你根本不需要刻意注意就能很好看。

lines.en: scene mikugirly11
: Stop bein’ so cool! Can’t ya see I’m goin’ through a crisis right now?!
lines.zh: : 别这么帅行不行！你没看到我正在经历一场危机吗？！

lines.en: : What do you want to do then? Go find an outfit that makes you feel more like “normal” Miku and less like the Miku that is presently giving me an erection?
lines.zh: : 那你想怎么办？去找一身让你更像“正常的”Miku、而不是现在这个看得我勃起的 Miku 的衣服？

lines.en: : Don’t go gettin’ one of those in public! People are already lookin’ over here because of the crossdressin’ boy you’re hangin’ out with!
lines.zh: : 别在公共场合搞出那个啊！大家已经在往这边看了，就因为你旁边站着个异装男孩！

lines.en: : Stop calling yourself a boy and go take your clothes off.
lines.zh: : 别再说自己是男孩了，去把衣服脱了。

lines.en: : Now?! This is goin’ way too fast!
lines.zh: : 现在？！这也太快了吧！

lines.en: : Just choose a store, Miku. Preferably sometime before summer.
lines.zh: : 选家店就行，Miku。最好能在夏天到来之前选好。

lines.en: scene mikugirly12
: Uhh...maybe that place Chika works at, then? They looked like they had a pretty decent variety when we went there that one time.
lines.zh: : 呃……那要不就去 Chika 打工的那家？我们上次去的时候，那儿看起来种类还挺多的。

lines.en: : Choose literally any other store.
lines.zh: : 除了那家，随便哪家都行。

lines.en: scene mikugirly13
: You avoidin’ Chika now? How come?
lines.zh: : 你在躲 Chika？为什么啊？

lines.en: : This another one of those girls Makoto’s suspicious of you spendin’ too much time with?
lines.zh: : 她也是 Makoto 怀疑你跟她待太久的那些女生之一吗？

lines.en: : Perhaps. I just know she’d get a little jealous if she saw me with you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。我只知道，要是她看到我和你在一起，她会有点吃醋。

lines.en: scene mikugirly14
: Chika? Jealous of me? You kiddin’?
lines.zh: : Chika？吃我的醋？你开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : She’s like...superstar pretty. And I’m just some weirdo walkin’ around in clothes clearly made for someone else.
lines.zh: : 她可是……明星级别的大美女。而我只是个穿着明显是为别人做的衣服到处晃的怪人。

lines.en: : She’d probably laugh me outta the store before gettin’ jealous about something like that.
lines.zh: : 她大概会先把我从店里笑出去，根本轮不到为这种事吃醋。

lines.en: : I think you’re gravely misunderstanding how cute you are, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你严重误解了自己有多可爱，Miku。

lines.en: : And I think you’re just gravely...wrong. But if it makes ya feel better, we can go somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得你只是严重……错了。不过要是能让你好受点，我们可以去别家。

lines.en: scene mikugirly15
: After that, though...we’re gettin’ ice cream whether ya like it or not.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之后……不管你愿不愿意，我们都得去吃冰淇淋。

lines.en: : Do I...seem like the type of person who is anti-ice cream?
lines.zh: : 我……看起来像是会反对冰淇淋的那种人吗？

lines.en: : You seem a little anti-everything, Sensei. But if we’re gonna be goin’ out on dates, you’re gonna be buyin’ me ice cream. Those are just the rules.
lines.zh: : 你看起来有点什么都要反对，Sensei。不过既然我们要开始约会了，你就得给我买冰淇淋。这就是规矩。

lines.en: : If that is what must be done...
lines.zh: : 如果这是非做不可的事……

lines.en: scene black
Despite being far more comfortable with the idea of {i}dating{/i} than I assumed she’d be, Miku still can’t seem to let go of the idea that she just doesn’t belong in feminine clothing.
lines.zh: 尽管 Miku 对“{i}约会{/i}”这件事的接受度比我预想的高得多，她似乎还是放不下那个念头——她就是不属于女性化的衣服。

lines.en: And, as excited as I am to get her out of said clothing, I do wish she’d maybe try and look at herself a little harder.
lines.zh: 而虽然我很兴奋能把她从那些衣服里剥出来，我确实希望她能试着更认真地看看自己。

lines.en: I guess feeling a little discomfort is to be expected though when you’ve finally got the opportunity to move around in someone else’s skin.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，当你终于有机会钻进别人的皮肤里活动一下，会有点不自在也是意料之中的。

lines.en: She just needs to grow into it.
lines.zh: 她只是需要时间去适应它。

lines.en: Don’t share that thought with her, though. She’ll think it’s a shot at her breasts.
lines.zh: 不过这话可别跟她说。她会以为你是在嘲讽她的胸部。

lines.en: Or...lack thereof, I suppose.
lines.zh: 或者……该说是嘲讽她没有胸部吧。

lines.en: Either way, the two of us walk through the mall together, mostly ignoring the fact that Miku is wearing a dress, and wind up at another familiar store.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们两个一起穿过商场，基本无视了 Miku 正穿着一条裙子这个事实，最后来到了另一家熟悉的店。

lines.en: scene mikugirly16
: What do you think, Sensei? Are high waisted shorts a little too girly, too? Should I try and get somethin’ a little...lower-waisted? Or would that just be called “normal?”
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Sensei？高腰短裤是不是也有点太女孩子气了？我是不是该挑点……低腰的？还是说那才叫“正常”？

lines.en: : This is exactly why I hate shoppin’ for stuff. I’ve got no idea how any of this fashion mumbo-jumbo works.
lines.zh: : 这就是我讨厌买衣服的原因。这些时尚的鬼话我一点都搞不懂。

lines.en: : Why does it matter if they’re girly or not? Who cares?
lines.zh: : 女孩子气不女孩子气有什么关系？谁在乎啊？

lines.en: : No one is expecting you to keep up the same appearance forever and I have no idea why you’re so dead set on it.
lines.zh: : 没人指望你永远保持同一个样子，我也不懂你为什么这么死脑筋。

lines.en: scene mikugirly17
: I don’t wanna hear that from somebody who’s been wearing the same heckin’ blazer for as long as I’ve known him.
lines.zh: : 这话我可不想从一个从我认识他起就一直穿着同一件该死的西装外套的人嘴里听到。

lines.en: : I’m only wearing this because it reminds me of the first time we kissed.
lines.zh: : 我穿这个，只是因为它让我想起我们第一次接吻的时候。

lines.en: : Ya think I’m actually gonna fall for that? You’re just smooth talkin’ me cause ya think it’ll get me to put out in the dressing room. I know your games, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你以为我真会信？你只是在哄我，因为你觉得这样就能让我在试衣间里就范。我知道你的把戏，Sensei。

lines.en: : Makoto should have never told you anything. That line would have worked out better if you didn’t know I was routinely having sex with your best friend.
lines.zh: : Makoto 真不该跟你说这些。要是你不知道我经常和你最好的朋友上床，那句台词本来会更有用的。

lines.en: scene mikugirly18
: What about this one? Is {i}this{/i} one too girly?
lines.zh: : 那这件呢？{i}这件{/i}会不会太女孩子气？

lines.en: Wow. I guess Miku really {i}is{/i} unfazed by the whole thing between Makoto and me, then.
lines.zh: 哇。看来 Miku 对 Makoto 和我之间的事{i}真的是{/i}毫不在意。

lines.en: I...don’t know how I feel about that.
lines.zh: 我……不知道自己对此是什么感觉。

lines.en: But I guess she does hang out with Kirin a fair bit, so maybe she’s just been negatively influenced in some way.
lines.zh: 不过她确实经常和 Kirin 混在一起，所以也许她只是受了某种不太好的影响。

lines.en: If you can even call the acceptance of relationships existing outside of your own personal bubble “negative” to begin with.
lines.zh: 如果你真能把“接受自己小圈子之外也存在别的恋爱关系”称作“不好”的话。

lines.en: Which you can’t, because that’s just how life works.
lines.zh: 而你并不能，因为生活本来就是这样的。

lines.en: But it would still be nice for her to get a {i}little{/i} bit jealous.
lines.zh: 不过，她要是能{i}稍微{/i}吃点醋，那也挺好的。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay...I...
: I think I’ve got somethin’.
lines.zh: : 我想我找到了。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, this’ll work.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，这个行。

lines.en: : Need me to come in there with you?
lines.zh: : 需要我进去陪你吗？

lines.en: : I know how to dress myself, ya friggin’ horn dog! Just wait out here and I’ll be done in a sec!
lines.zh: : 我自己会穿衣服，你这该死的色狼！就在这儿等着，我马上就好！

lines.en: Maybe one day...
lines.zh: 也许有一天……

lines.en: scene mikugirly19
: Good? Bad? What’s the verdict?
lines.zh: : 好？还是不好？判决是什么？

lines.en: : You look nice. I think I prefer the dress, though.
lines.zh: : 你看起来很好。不过我觉得我更喜欢那条裙子。

lines.en: : I like the dress too, but...I just ain’t ready yet, Sensei. Stuff like this is what I’m more comfortable in.
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢那条裙子，可是……我还没准备好，Sensei。穿这种衣服我才更自在。

lines.en: : I’m fine with tryin’ to go a little more outside of my comfort zone, but...I’ve gotta take baby steps.
lines.zh: : 我愿意试着多走出一点舒适区，可是……我得一步一步来。

lines.en: : Ain’t always right to expect yourself on the starting roster if it’s your rookie season, ya know?
lines.zh: : 新秀赛季就指望自己进首发名单，那也不太现实，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Not really, but I’ll trust your judgement.
lines.zh: : 不太懂，不过我相信你的判断。

lines.en: : What you wear or the way you choose to style your hair doesn’t really make any difference to me. So as long as you’re happy, I’m fine with it.
lines.zh: : 你穿什么、头发怎么弄，对我来说真的没什么区别。所以只要你开心，我就没问题。

lines.en: scene mikugirly20
: Guess it’s settled, then! Summer Miku’s makin’ her debut appearance before summer even begins!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了！“夏日 Miku”要在夏天还没开始之前就首次亮相了！

lines.en: : She’s also about to actually spend money on clothes for the first time in forever! So that’s a big step in...some sorta direction as well! Thanks for the help, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 而且她这辈子头一回真的要花钱给自己买衣服了！所以这也是朝……某个方向迈出的一大步！谢谢你的帮忙，Sensei！

lines.en: : What help? All I did was stand here and say you look cute a few times.
lines.zh: : 帮什么忙？我只是站在这儿说了几次你很可爱而已。

lines.en: scene mikugirly21
: Exactly! That was all ya needed to do.
lines.zh: : 就是啊！你需要做的就只有这个。

lines.en: : Sometimes, girls just need moral support. We say a bunch of stuff that’s been squirmin’ around our minds cause we want ya to disagree with us.
lines.zh: : 有时候，女孩子需要的只是精神上的支持。我们会把一堆在脑子里打转的话说出来，因为我们想让你来反驳我们。

lines.en: : You not doin' that means you passed the test!
lines.zh: : 你没有反驳，就说明你通过测试了！

lines.en: : Test?
lines.zh: : 测试？

lines.en: scene mikugirly22
: The test to prove that I actually {i}do{/i} like ya after all!
lines.zh: : 就是证明我果然是{i}真的{/i}喜欢你的测试！

lines.en: : Sorry Makoto, but Miku Maruyama ain’t backin’ down any time soon!
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦 Makoto，不过 Miku Maruyama 可不会轻易退场的！

lines.en: scene black

Miku goes back into the dressing room to gather the dress her {s}best friend{/s} rival bought for her and decides that she’s just going to keep wearing her {i}new{/i} new outfit for the rest of the “date.”
lines.zh: Miku 回到试衣间，把她那位“{s}闺蜜{/s}兼情敌”给她买的裙子收好，然后决定在剩下的“约会”里就继续穿着她的{i}新{/i}衣服。

lines.en: While we’re waiting in line to pay, it becomes increasingly apparent that mostly all of her nerves have departed with the addition of new clothing or, to harken back to an earlier metaphor-
lines.zh: 我们排队付钱的时候，越来越明显地看出来，随着这身新衣服加身，她的紧张感基本已经烟消云散了——或者说，用回先前的那个比喻——

lines.en: A different set of skin.
lines.zh: 换了一层皮肤。

lines.en: We leave the store in a hurry as Miku returns to her normal self and, within a matter of minutes, she has the {i}other{/i} thing she came here for as well...
lines.zh: 我们匆匆离开店里，Miku 也恢复了平常的自己，而没过几分钟，她来这儿的{i}另一件{/i}目的也达成了……

lines.en: scene mikugirly23
: Here! I went ahead and got you vanilla since you seem so boring and normal all the time.
lines.zh: : 给！我自作主张给你买了香草味，因为你看起来一直都是那么无聊又普通。

lines.en: : That’s a very offensive thing to say to someone who just bought you ice cream.
lines.zh: : 对一个刚给你买了冰淇淋的人说这种话，可是相当冒犯啊。

lines.en: scene mikugirly24
: I’m obviously just kiddin’, Sensei. I don’t think you’re normal at all.
lines.zh: : 我显然是在开玩笑啦，Sensei。我一点都不觉得你普通。

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ even remotely normal about gettin’ locked inside of a love triangle with two students. Let alone ones as young as-
lines.zh: : 被困在两个学生组成的三角恋里，这本身就再不普通不过了。更别说她们还这么年——

lines.en: : Yes, thank you for acknowledging how inappropriate and abnormal our situation is. I would never have recognized it otherwise and I thank you for setting me down the right path.
lines.zh: : 好，谢谢你承认我们的处境有多么不合适、多么不正常。不然我永远都不会意识到这一点，感谢你把我引回正道。

lines.en: : Well, wherever that path is headed, I hope I can walk it with ya.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管那条路通向哪里，我都希望能和你一起走下去。

lines.en: : I might not be as smart or feminine as the other girls, but I’ve got tons of energy and I can’t think of anybody I’d rather spend it on than you.
lines.zh: : 我也许没有别的女生那么聪明、那么有女人味，可我有的是精力，而我想不出还有谁比我更愿意把这精力花在你身上。

lines.en: : Now eat your friggin’ ice cream before it starts to melt!
lines.zh: : 现在快把你那份该死的冰淇淋吃了，趁它还没化！

lines.en: : We’ve got lots more hangin’ out to do!
lines.zh: : 我们还有很多时间要一起逛呢！

lines.en: scene black
$ miku_love += 3
$ mikuspecial50 = True
{i}Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump mikudorm50
